notes.title: 23th October, Major update
notes.content:
http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/30366159/02b54683c3e05e9d81772690c38477dbdd3ac735.gif

Hi everyone,

We are pleased to announce that we are finally updating new contents for Toy Clash. There are 16 new stages decorated in a volcanic theme, with 4 new enemy characters including a gigantic boss monster. And one more thing, you now can see the ending scene at the end of the game!

But these are not the final contents you will have in Toy Clash. We are also working on more contents for future updates, so I hope you enjoy our recent new update until we bring you another one!
